notes: Explicit OP shop lists from the linked event outfit sections. CN inventories and dates are projections for Global, not confirmed Global sales. Shop openings without a separate start use the event opening. event-estimate uses the event window because the source does not specify shop dates. Fashion Review random-outfit draws do not establish OP shop availability. Fashion Review inventories are explicit cumulative Store/Fashion Review lists (196 through People, A People; 207 through Act or Die Rerun). event-estimate dates are planning estimates against the event shop, not announced Global windows. Later CN People, A People returns are also listed against the Global celebration as an event estimate because Global rearranges those shops.
